item.title: Why some key GOP candidates are skipping Trump-backed midterm convention
item.description: President Trump and top GOP leaders are gathering in Dallas for a midterm convention, though some Republicans in competitive races are opting to skip it and campaign in their home districts or states.

item.title: Fetterman appears at RNC midterm convention in surprise video
item.description: Democratic Sen. John Fetterman appeared in a surprise video at the Republican Party's midterm convention on Wednesday, as he becomes increasingly isolated from his own party.

item.title: NTSB releases footage of Miami cargo plane crash site
item.description: The National Transportation Safety Board on Wednesday released videos of investigators combing through the debris and wreckage of an Amazon cargo plane that crashed in Miami on Sunday, killing five people and injuring five others. CBS News correspondent Skyler Henry has the latest on the investigation.

item.title: Why a lighthouse keeper job posting got such an "overwhelming response"
item.description: The National Park Service is looking for a volunteer to staff the Point Reyes Lighthouse, built during the Grant Administration. Tony Dokoupil has more on the job.

item.title: Anthropic researcher says more than 10% chance AI "could kill all humans"
item.description: A top Anthropic researcher says there's more than a 10% chance AI "could kill all humans," after a colleague resigned over similar concerns.

item.title: Dolly Parton's sister on why she had a small, private funeral
item.description: Two weeks after her death at 80, a new song from Dolly Parton was released called "Bound to Ride," as part of an upcoming tribute album to the Stanley Brothers. Gayle King spoke exclusively with Dolly Parton's younger sister in an interview that will air on "CBS Mornings" on Thursday.

item.title: 9/11 widow establishes school in her late husband's honor
item.description: CBS Weekend News producer Caroline Lewis shares the story of her mother Julie, who established a school servicing an impoverished community in honor of her late husband, Adam Lewis, a KBW banker who was killed on 9/11.

item.title: Ohio man living in squalor with 16 grandchildren mentally incompetent to stand trial
item.description: Investigators said the children, who weren't enrolled in school, remained mostly confined to a small room in the house under deplorable conditions.

item.title: Under Taliban control, Afghan girls write "letters to the world" from their secret school
item.description: Afghanistan, now once again under Taliban control, has banned girls from school after the sixth grade. Imtiaz Tyab found a secret school hidden in a quiet corner of Kabul, where girls aged 14 to 16 are working through advanced calculus.

item.title: Trump counts on midterm convention to boost Republican candidates for midterms
item.description: The first-ever Republican midterm convention is underway in Dallas, with control of the House and Senate on the line and Election Day less than eight weeks away. President Trump is set to headline. Ed O'Keefe reports from the event.

item.title: Trump counts on midterm convention to boost Republican candidates for midterms
item.description: The first-ever Republican midterm convention is underway in Dallas, with control of the House and Senate on the line and Election Day less than eight weeks away. President Trump is set to headline. Ed O'Keefe reports from the event.

item.title: Video shows would-be killer pointing gun at ex-wife before it jams in a crowded restaurant
item.description: A potential killing was caught on camera in Ohio and was revealed at the trial of a man found guilty of attempting to shoot his wife in a crowded restaurant. Mark Strassmann reports.

item.title: Anthropic model gains access to third-party organization without permission, company says
item.description: A lead researcher at Anthropic said "AI could kill all humans" on Tuesday, giving it a more than 10% chance within the next decade. The call now is for a global conversation about risk and safety. Jo Ling Kent has more from Silicon Valley, and Tristan Harris, co-founder of the Center for Humane Technology, goes deeper.

item.title: Expert calls for ban on development of AI superintelligence amid human extinction concerns
item.description: Connor Leahy, U.S. executive director of ControlAI, joins "The Daily Report" to share his perspective on concerns that AI superintelligence poses a threat to humans.

item.title: Destructive hurricanes cause damage in California, Hawaii
item.description: In Hawaii, tens of thousands cleaned up and waited for their power to be restored in the aftermath of Hurricane Lowell. The storm killed at least one person. Along the Southern California coast, what's left of Hurricane Marie pummeled the shore with powerful surf, threatening beachfront homes. Carter Evans reports on the damage.

item.title: Trump claims Iran war will end after midterms as he campaigns for Republicans
item.description: President Trump is claiming an end to the Iran war is in sight as he campaigns with Republicans ahead of the midterms. Meanwhile, his trade war with Canada and new claims about his personal experience with 9/11 are raising questions. CBS News' Nancy Cordes has more.

item.title: Trump to speak at first ever GOP midterm convention
item.description: The first-ever Republican midterm convention is underway in Dallas, Texas, with President Trump expected to speak both Wednesday and Thursday night. CBS News' Ed O'Keefe reports.

item.title: New documentary looks at generation that grew up after 9/11 attacks
item.description: A new Netflix documentary is out about those who were children in the wake of the 9/11 attacks. "Turning Point: Generation 9/11" profiles people whose parents died on that day, as well as soldiers who joined the military because of 9/11. Director Brian Knappenberger joins "The Takeout" to discuss the making of the film.

item.title: Kelly Loeffler says GOP midterm convention will focus on Trump's "historic presidency"
item.description: The first-ever Republican midterm convention is underway in Dallas, where the GOP is preparing for President Trump to speak on Wednesday and Thursday. Kelly Loeffler, administrator of the Small Business Administration, joins "The Takeout" from the convention floor.

item.title: Trump gifted $45,000 to Natalie Harp and 2 other aides, federal disclosures show
item.description: Federal disclosures show President Trump gave three of his aides cash gifts of $45,000. Politico White House reporter Sophia Cai and Washington Sun Senate reporter Igor Bobic join to discuss.

item.title: Texas Senate candidate James Talarico: Voters are "tired of this professional wrestling" in politics
item.description: Texas Democrat James Talarico has received an endorsement from a former top aide to Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton in the Lone Star State's Senate race. CBS News senior White House and political correspondent Ed O'Keefe spoke with Talarico about the state of his campaign and more.

item.title: Rep. Lori Trahan says it's time for Congress to "finally get off the sidelines" and regulate AI
item.description: An employee for the artificial intelligence company Anthropic has resigned over concerns that AI could spiral out of control and destroy humanity. Democratic Rep. Lori Trahan of Massachusetts, a staunch advocate for AI regulation, joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: Federal judge backs Missouri's new House map after Supreme Court rebuffs case
item.description: A federal judge ruled that Missouri should use a new congressional map that favors Republicans for now, hours after the U.S. Supreme Court left in place a ruling from the state's highest court directing Missouri to use an older map.

item.title: NYC after 9/11: 25 years of remembering and rebuilding
item.description: A look back at how 9/11 has changed Lower Manhattan and beyond, 25 years after the World Trade Center attacks.

item.title: 9/9: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: President Trump bans some Canadian imports and threatens more tariffs; Anthropic employee quits over risk AI poses to humanity.

item.title: CBS News poll finds that 25 years after 9/11 most see changed country
item.description: A big majority say it's very important that Americans remember the 9/11 attacks.

item.title: Full interview: James Talarico on affordability, Paxton's AI ads and more
item.description: CBS News senior White House and political correspondent Ed O'Keefe spoke with Texas Democrat James Talarico on Wednesday about his agenda if he's elected to the Senate, the state of his race against Texas Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton and more. Watch the full interview.

item.title: The U.S. just had its hottest summer on record, NOAA says
item.description: Average temperatures across the U.S. soared to record heights between June and August in 2026, a new report found.

item.title: Trump gave $45,000 gift to Natalie Harp, 2 other aides
item.description: A White House spokesperson said in a statement on Wednesday that Mr. Trump "has a longstanding practice of giving Christmas gifts to people in his orbit."

item.title: Some fliers may be able to bring water through TSA checkpoints soon, officials say
item.description: The TSA is not prepared to eliminate all liquid restrictions, and the existing rule limiting other carry-on liquids to 3.4 ounces remains in effect.
